name: Bánh canh chả cá Cù Lao Chàm
summary: Bánh canh chả cá is the afternoon noodle soup filled with the island fish paste, the change from the rice meal.
origin: Cham Islands. An afternoon bowl on Tân Hiệp, filled with the island fish paste.
howToEat: In the afternoon, for visitors and islanders, along the Bai Lang coast road and by the well in Bai Ong.
where: The Bai Lang coast road and the stalls by Giếng Xóm Cấm in Bai Ong, where the study places the afternoon food.
seoTitle: Bánh canh chả cá — fish-paste noodles, Cham Islands
seoDescription: Noodle soup filled with the island’s fish paste, afternoon food on the Bai Lang coast road.
